scope: build-host side only; no claims about watch runtime behaviour
method: iterative devtool modify/build cycles in a workspace recipe on the w541 (Arch bare metal, native, no container); sources rsynced from the git-managed clone with no git work in the build tree; failures read from log.do_* files rather than bitbake summaries; each fix verified by re-running the failing task

findings.title: cmake-native picks up the host's libidn2
findings.mechanism: vendored curl does an unconditional set(USE_LIBIDN2 ON) then find_package(Libidn2); Yocto hides host includes but not host linker search paths, so the library is found, configure passes, and the compile dies on the missing header
findings.generalisation: Yocto host isolation covers include paths more thoroughly than linker search paths; a find_package that probes for a library can succeed against the host while its header is invisible
evidence: compile failure on missing libidn2 headers after a successful configure
fix verified by rebuild after cleansstate
findings.gotcha: must be CMAKE_EXTRACONF, not EXTRA_OECMAKE — cmake-native bootstraps itself and does not read EXTRA_OECMAKE, so setting that looks like a failed fix

findings.title: systemd-systemctl-native picks up the host's PAM
findings.mechanism: meson finds /usr/lib/libpam.so on the host and enables PAM; compile then fails on security/pam_ext.h — same host-contamination family as F1

findings.title: asteroid-generate-desktop fails opaquely on a missing i18n header
findings.mechanism: the script requires BOTH <src>/<app>.desktop.template and <src>/i18n/<app>.desktop.h (default name as //% "Name", read via grep -oP '//% "\K[^"]+(?=")'), and exit 2s if either is missing
sub_issues: failure surfaces far from the cause: no .desktop is produced and the build dies later in do_install with a bare 'CMake Error at cmake_install.cmake:61 (file): No such file or directory' — no filename, no mention of the generator
the two-input requirement is undocumented in the app template; an app shipping only a .desktop.template looks complete and is not
prints 'Couldn't find a corresponding language id, aborting' and exits 0 when the i18n/*.ts glob matches nothing (normal for a new app) — reads as the error when it is harmless
findings.suggested_upstream: fail loudly at configure time naming the missing path; downgrade the empty-.ts message so it does not read as an abort
findings.status: fixed locally; reported here for upstream

findings.title: configure-time generators make a correct fix look wrong
findings.mechanism: generate_desktop() runs at CMake configure time via execute_process, so adding the header did nothing until do_configure re-ran; devtool reused the cached configure and the rebuild reproduced the identical error
findings.tell: the error cites an unchanged task-log ID — check that before re-deriving the fix
practices_adopted: bitbake -c cleansstate <app> before any rebuild meant to prove a configure-time fix (now in the build script)
verify a configure-time generator by running it by hand against the staged source before spending a build cycle

findings.title: devtool build does not produce an installable package
findings.mechanism: devtool build stops after do_packagedata, reports full success, and leaves deploy/ipk empty; the ipk requires an explicit bitbake -c package_write_ipk
findings.impact: reads as a silent build failure; pairs confusingly with a-d-b's install op reporting 'no ipk found' after a successful build

not_verified: installation on nemo — the unit was unreachable on both transports at the end of this arc (no adb device; SSH to 192.168.2.15 timed out)
the app running, the icon rendering in the launcher, and the results round-trip all remain open
dead_ends: chased cmake_install.cmake:61 as a CMake bug before reading the generator script; the line number was accurate and the message useless — reading the generator's preconditions was what solved it
assumed the first rebuild had disproved the header fix; it had not run the fix at all (F4)
